purpose: records which implementation the plan section 3 allowed was used; changes nothing in the frozen analysis

espmap.note: v0.3 --ensemble was not released before the run, so the pilot selection code was used (plan section 3). No v0.3 member is mixed in.

selection.rule: rg_spread: lowest MMFF94s + 19 spread over RDKit RadiusOfGyration (mass-weighted, all atoms); bench/conformers.select at v0.2.1; no RMSD dedup

method: B3LYP/def2-SVP + RI, gas, 0.26 bohr, nearest-nucleus primary, radius-scaled alongside
folded: intramolecular contact (espmap master 5175515 rule: heavy atoms >= 5 bonds apart, < Bondi sum + 0.5 A) OR surface genus > 0, as the frozen plan defines it
first_member: 2026-10-23T18:2x+09:00 (trial e3_z13_18_oac conf_00 before the main run)
manifest_written: 2026-10-23T20:20+09:00, after 30 of 100 members had run; nothing in it was chosen after seeing a member
scripts: s001_run.py (select, run), s001_build.py, s001_analyse.py, s001_report.py; committed with the records
